一位以“青岚圣女·风”为主题的东方幻想女性角色设定图（符合10岁以下萌娃小仙女气质），灵感来自白族、纳西遗韵、苍山风灵与自然之风。年轻绝美女性，冷白通透肌肤，五官精致柔美，眼神清澈空灵，气质温柔圣洁、灵动飘逸，仿佛风与山岚的化身。
人物乌黑浓密长发高挽云髻，发丝自然飞扬，带有被风吹起的轻盈动感。头戴华丽银白羽饰凤冠，冠饰由银丝、白羽、青绿色宝石、珍珠、流苏、水滴吊坠组成，造型轻盈如飞鸟展翼。额间佩戴银色流苏额饰，垂坠一枚青绿色水滴宝石，耳边佩戴羽毛与宝石流苏耳饰，颈部佩戴多层银饰项链与圆形青绿色主宝石胸饰。
服装为青绿色、薄荷绿、浅蓝、银白渐变的东方幻想圣女长裙，融合民族服饰与仙侠礼服设计。上身为精致银线刺绣束身衣，点缀青绿色宝石、珍珠与银饰链条，肩部有薄纱披帛与羽毛装饰。腰部为银白镂空腰封，悬挂玉石流苏、银链、羽片与水滴吊坠。裙摆层层叠叠，材质轻盈透明，薄纱、绸缎、雪纺交织，青绿渐变如山间清风与云雾，裙面布满银白风纹、云纹、羽纹、花卉刺绣与细密珠绣，整体飘逸华丽。

widgets_values: Style: cinematic-realistic fantasy character illustration. The image presents a young East Asian-inspired fantasy maiden embodying the theme "Green Mist Holy Maiden · Wind", with Bai and Naxi heritage echoes, Cangshan mountain wind spirit symbolism, and a gentle childlike fairy temperament. She has cool fair translucent skin, delicate soft facial features, clear ethereal eyes, and a calm holy yet lively expression, appearing as though she is the living form of wind and mountain mist. Her long dense black hair is styled in a high cloud-like traditional updo, with loose strands naturally flying outward to show light wind movement. On her head is an ornate silver-white feathered phoenix crown made of silver wire, white feathers, turquoise-green gemstones, pearls, tassels, and teardrop pendants, shaped like a bird spreading its wings. A silver tassel forehead ornament hangs from the crown, ending in a turquoise teardrop gemstone at the center of her brow. She wears feather-and-gem tassel earrings beside her ears, layered silver necklaces around her neck, and a round turquoise main gemstone chest pendant. Her dress is a gradient of teal green, mint green, pale blue, and silver-white, combining ethnic costume details with xianxia ceremonial gown design. The upper garment is a fitted bodice embroidered with fine silver thread, decorated with turquoise gems, pearls, and silver chain ornaments. Thin gauze shawls and feather decorations rest over her shoulders. Around her waist is a silver-white hollow waist belt hanging with jade tassels, silver chains, feather pieces, and teardrop pendants. The skirt is layered and flowing, made of translucent tulle, satin, and chiffon interwoven in a teal-green gradient like mountain breeze and cloud mist, covered with silver-white wind patterns, cloud motifs, feather patterns, floral embroidery, and delicate beadwork. The lighting is soft, diffused, and luminous, with a cool green-blue color grade that reinforces the wind-and-mountain atmosphere. The background resembles a misty alpine valley or temple garden, with blurred cliffs, trees, clouds, and architectural silhouettes behind her. The camera uses a medium-full portrait framing, slightly low angle, shallow depth of field, and gentle motion in the hair, fabric, and ornaments to convey wind. The overall mood is serene, sacred, elegant, and otherworldly. There is no visible text in the image.
